predecessors.name: Colony of New South Wales
predecessors.text: the New South Wales territory south of the Murray River, 'the former Port Phillip District of NSW'

successors.name: Commonwealth of Australia
successors.text: Victoria, which 'federated with other colonies to form the Commonwealth of Australia' on 1 January 1901

ledger.x: 1851: Victoria separates from New South Wales.

wars.name: Eureka Rebellion
wars.outcome: 'The Eureka Rebellion of 1854, a miners' uprising against oppressive mining licenses and lack of representation'; no land changed hands and no rebel state held ground.
